title: Inception
description: A thief who steals information through dream-sharing is offered a chance to regain his old life in exchange for planting an idea in a CEO's mind.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who threatens to plunge Gotham into chaos.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl enters a mysterious spirit world and must find the courage to save her parents.

title: La La Land
description: A jazz musician and an aspiring actress fall in love while chasing their dreams in Los Angeles.

title: Dune
description: Paul Atreides navigates a dangerous desert world as his family comes into conflict with rival houses.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.
